cards.q_zh: 如何从骨架化学位移获得二级结构信息？如何检测 IDP 中的瞬时二级结构？
cards.a:
方法一：算 CSI（化学位移指数）——Cα、Cβ、CO 的实测位移与无规卷曲值的偏差，偏差模式指示螺旋/片/卷曲。方法二：输入 TALOS 预测 φ/ψ。
CSI（位移偏差）或 TALOS。
检测 IDP 瞬时二级结构：看化学位移偏差（瞬时结构也会反映在平均位移上），或 NOE、异核 NOE、弛豫参数、氢交换速率。
IDP 瞬时结构：看位移偏差 + NOE/弛豫/氢交换。
WHY：化学位移对二级结构极敏感（螺旋/片/卷曲各有特征偏差），即使瞬时（部分占据）也会反映在平均化学位移上 → 可用位移偏差检测瞬时结构。
WHY：化学位移敏感二级结构，瞬时也反映在平均值。
记忆点：Cα 位移偏正、Cβ 偏负 → α 螺旋；Cα 偏负、Cβ 偏正 → β 片；接近无规卷曲值 → 无序。
记忆点：Cα 正/Cβ 负=螺旋；Cα 负/Cβ 正=片。

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q1 — Image formation & distortion (2 pt)::0
cards.q_en: ** Explain the main steps of image formation in an electron microscope. The collected image is distorted — explain why.
cards.q_zh: ** 解释电镜成像的主要步骤。采集到的图像是扭曲的——为什么？
cards.a:
Electrons are accelerated by high voltage (de Broglie λ = h/mv, short wavelength → high resolution); the condenser lens makes a parallel beam; electrons interact with the sample producing amplitude contrast (particle view, scattering → darker) + phase contrast (wave view, scattered electrons delayed by π/2, interference). (1 pt)
电子经高压加速（德布罗意 λ=h/mv，短波长→高分辨）；聚光镜产生平行束；电子与样品作用产生振幅衬度（粒子观，散射→更暗）+ 相位衬度（波动观，散射电子相位延迟 π/2，干涉成像）。（1 分）
Distortion is due to lens aberrations (spherical Cs, chromatic Cc, astigmatism) + underfocus (needed for phase contrast); in Fourier space, image = real image × CTF, which oscillates so some frequencies are lost/inverted. (1 pt)
扭曲源于透镜像差（球差 Cs、色差 Cc、像散）+ 欠焦（为获得相位衬度必须欠焦）；傅里叶空间 记录图像 = 真实图像 × CTF，CTF 振荡导致某些频率信息丢失/反转。（1 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q2 — From particles to 2D class averages (1.5 pt)::1
cards.q_en: ** Give the main steps to obtain 2D class averages from picked particles, and why each is important.
cards.q_zh: ** 给出从挑选颗粒得到二维平均类的主要步骤，及每步为何重要。
cards.a:
Translation (centering) — center the particles, otherwise the average is blurred. (0.5 pt)
平移（居中）—— 否则平均会模糊。（0.5 分）
Rotation (alignment) — align same-orientation particles. (0.5 pt)
旋转（对齐）—— 对齐同取向颗粒。（0.5 分）
Classification (MSA/Bayesian) to separate orientations/conformations + averaging (S/N improves by √N). (0.5 pt)
分类（MSA/Bayesian）分离不同取向/构象 + 平均（信噪比提高 √N）。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q3 — Symmetry of the complex (0.5 pt)::2
cards.q_en: ** What is the symmetry of the complex? Explain why.
cards.q_zh: ** 复合物的对称性是什么？为什么？
cards.a:
C6 (six-fold rotational symmetry, a hexameric ring). WHY: 360 kDa / 60 kDa = 6 subunits → hexameric ring with C6 symmetry. (0.5 pt)
C6（六重旋转对称，六聚体环）。WHY：360 kDa / 60 kDa = 6 个亚基 → 六聚体环，C6 对称。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q4 — Euler sphere & asymmetric unit (1 pt)::3

cards.q_zh: ** 在你画的欧拉球上标出不对称单元并给出边界欧拉角。
cards.a:
Draw a Euler sphere (φ, θ, ψ). C6 has 6 symmetry operations → the asymmetric unit = 1/6 of the Euler sphere. (0.5 pt)
画欧拉球 (φ, θ, ψ)。C6 有 6 个对称操作 → 不对称单元 = 欧拉球的 1/6。（0.5 分）
Borders: ψ (around the main axis) from 0° to 60° (360°/6); search only in this wedge. (0.5 pt)
边界：ψ（绕主轴）从 0° 到 60°（即 360°/6）；只需在这个楔形内搜索。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q5 — Retrieving missing information (0.5 pt)::4
cards.q_en: ** Explain the strategy to retrieve the information missing in single images.
cards.q_zh: ** 解释找回单张图像缺失信息的策略。
cards.a:
A single image is a 2D projection (losing the projection direction); collect many projections at different orientations + assign Euler angles + 3D reconstruction fills the missing views. (0.5 pt)
单张图只是 3D 物体的 2D 投影（丢失投影方向信息）；采集大量不同取向投影 + 分配欧拉角 + 三维重构补全缺失视角。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q6 — Common line method (1 pt)::5
cards.q_en: ** Explain the strategy to obtain relative angles between class averages using the common line method.
cards.q_zh: ** 解释用共线法求类平均之间相对角度的策略。
cards.a:
Central section theorem: the FT of one projection = a central section through the origin of the 3D object's FT. (0.5 pt)
中心截面定理：一张投影的傅里叶变换 = 3D 物体傅里叶变换过原点的中心截面。（0.5 分）
Two class averages' FT sections intersect along a common line in Fourier space; its direction difference in the two sections gives their relative Euler angles. (0.5 pt)
两个类平均的 FT 截面在傅里叶空间交于一条共线；该线在两截面中的方向差异给出它们的相对欧拉角。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q7 — Improve resolution of the flexible substrate (2 pt)::6
cards.q_en: ** After refinement, the substrate (transiently bound) is less resolved than the unfoldase and appears in several positions. Explain a strategy to improve its resolution.
cards.q_zh: ** 精修后，瞬时结合的底物比去折叠酶更模糊且出现在多个位置。解释提高其分辨率的策略。
cards.a:
Signal subtraction: subtract the rigid ClpX body → only substrate density remains. (0.5 pt)
信号扣除：扣掉刚性良好的 ClpX 主体 → 只剩底物密度。（0.5 分）
Masked 3D classification: apply a soft mask on the substrate region to separate particles with different substrate positions. (1 pt)
掩膜 3D 分类：对底物区域加软掩膜，把不同底物位置的颗粒分成不同类。（1 分）
Local refinement of each substrate state with a mask. (0.5 pt)
局部精修：对每个底物状态用掩膜做聚焦精修。（0.5 分）
WHY: multiple positions = heterogeneity; separate first, then refine each state to boost that region's S/N.
WHY：底物多位置 = 异质性，先分离再分别精修才能提高该区域信噪比。

cards.q_en: ** Describe the major differences between a TEM image and an AFM image.

TEM: electrons transmit through the sample → 2D projection (incl. internal structure), high vacuum, high resolution. (0.5 pt)

cards.a:
① X-rays scatter on electrons (∝ electron number); neutrons scatter on nuclei (varies irregularly with isotope). (0.25 pt)

③ SAXS: high flux, fast, radiation damage; SANS: low flux, slow, no radiation damage. (0.25 pt)
③ SAXS 高通量、快、有辐射损伤；SANS 低通量、慢、无辐射损伤。（0.25 分）

蛋白-RNA 复合物 → SANS（天然对比度区分两部分）。（0.25 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q3 — I(0) change (0.5 pt)::11
cards.q_en: ** Protein A is measured by SAXS. Protein B (15% of A's mass) is titrated 1:1 forming a tight complex with no free A or B. What is the relative change (in %) of I(0)?
cards.q_zh: ** 蛋白 A 用 SAXS 测量。蛋白 B（A 质量的 15%）按 1:1 滴定形成紧密复合物，无游离 A/B。I(0) 的相对变化（%）是多少？
cards.a:
+32%. WHY: I(0) ∝ Mr² (fixed particle number). I(0)_after / I(0)_before = (1.15 M_A)² / M_A² = 1.3225 → a 32% increase. (0.5 pt)
+32%。WHY：I(0) ∝ Mr²（固定颗粒数）。I(0)_后 / I(0)_前 = (1.15 M_A)² / M_A² = 1.3225 → 增加 32%。（0.5 分）
--

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q1 — PALM vs STORM (1.5 pt)::12
cards.q_en: ** Explain the difference between PALM and STORM. What resolution is achievable? Can they distinguish dimer vs monomer?
cards.q_zh: ** 解释 PALM 与 STORM 的区别。能达到什么分辨率？能区分二聚体/单体吗？
cards.a:
PALM = photoactivatable fluorescent proteins; STORM = photoswitchable organic dyes; both are SMLM. (0.5 pt)
PALM = 光激活荧光蛋白；STORM = 光开关有机染料；都是 SMLM。（0.5 分）
Resolution ≈ 10–40 nm. (0.5 pt)
分辨率 ≈ 10–40 nm。（0.5 分）
Localization resolution alone is insufficient (dimer subunits <10 nm apart); but counting blinking/bleaching steps works: monomer = 1 step, dimer = 2 steps. (0.5 pt)
仅靠定位分辨率不足以区分（二聚体亚基间距 <10 nm）；但数闪烁/漂白步数可以：单体 1 步、二聚体 2 步。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q2 — Stoichiometric labeling (1.25 pt)::13
cards.q_en: ** For counting, what labeling strategy ensures perfectly controlled stoichiometry?
cards.q_zh: ** 计数需要化学计量标记，采用什么策略？
cards.a:
Endogenous labeling via CRISPR/Cas9 knock-in: replace the endogenous gene with an FP-fused copy → every protein carries exactly 1 fluorophore (1:1 stoichiometry). (1.25 pt)
CRISPR/Cas9 内源敲入：把内源基因替换为 FP 融合版本 → 每个蛋白恰带 1 个荧光团（1:1 化学计量）。（1.25 分）

cards.q_en: ** What illumination method is advisable for a membrane protein?
cards.q_zh: ** 膜蛋白建议用什么照明方式？
cards.a:
TIRF (illuminates only ~100–200 nm near the coverslip, excluding intracellular background). (0.25 pt)
TIRF（只激发盖玻片附近 ~100–200 nm，排除胞内背景）。（0.25 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q4 — Photoconvertible FP (0.75 pt)::15
cards.q_en: ** Explain how a red-to-green photoconvertible fluorescent protein works in super-resolution.
cards.q_zh: ** 解释红转绿光转换荧光蛋白在超分辨中如何工作。
cards.a:
Starts emitting green; 405 nm activation rearranges the chromophore to emit red. In super-resolution: weak 405 nm activates a sparse subset → localize each red point until bleached → activate the next batch → temporal separation → single-molecule reconstruction. (0.75 pt)
初始发绿光；405 nm 激活后发色团重排转红。超分辨中：弱 405 nm 只激活稀疏分子→单独定位红光点→漂白→再激活下一批 → 时间分离→单分子定位重建。（0.75 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q5 — Transient transfection (0.75 pt)::16
cards.q_en: ** Why does transient transfection not label all proteins? How to label all?
cards.q_zh: ** 为什么瞬时转染不能标记全部？如何标记全部？
cards.a:
Transient transfection → overexpression, random copy number, not all cells express, endogenous copies unlabeled. (0.5 pt)
瞬时转染 → 过表达、随机拷贝数、非所有细胞表达、内源蛋白未标记。（0.5 分）
CRISPR/Cas9 endogenous knock-in (or a stable line) → all endogenous proteins labeled 1:1. (0.25 pt)
CRISPR/Cas9 内源敲入（或稳定细胞系）→ 所有内源蛋白 1:1 标记。（0.25 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q6 — Temporal discrimination (0.5 pt)::17
cards.q_en: ** All labeled. How to distinguish dimer from monomer from photo-activation→bleaching events?
cards.q_zh: ** 全部已标记。如何从光激活→漂白事件区分二聚体/单体？
cards.a:
Count photobleaching steps: monomer = 1 step; dimer = 2 steps (intensity drops in steps). (0.5 pt)
数漂白步数：单体 = 1 步；二聚体 = 2 步（荧光强度阶梯式下降）。（0.5 分）

cards.q_en: ** Describe a strategy to answer this question.
cards.q_zh: ** 描述回答此问题的策略。
cards.a:
Use cellular TEM (thin sections): fix → embed → section → stain → TEM; look for electron-dense gold particles inside the cells. (1 pt)
用细胞 TEM 超薄切片：固定→包埋→切片→染色→TEM，在细胞内部寻找电子致密的金颗粒。（1 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q2 — Which microscope & why (0.5 pt)::19
cards.q_en: ** What microscope will be used? Why?
cards.q_zh: ** 用什么显微镜？为什么？
cards.a:
TEM. Gold (high atomic number) is electron-dense → high-contrast dark dots; resolution is enough to see 10 nm particles and their subcellular location. (0.5 pt)
TEM。金（高原子序数）电子致密 → 高衬度黑点，分辨率足以看清 10 nm 颗粒及其亚细胞定位。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 1.md::### Q3 — Sample preparation (0.5 pt)::20
cards.q_en: ** How do you prepare the biological sample?
cards.q_zh: ** 如何制备生物样品？
cards.a:
Glutaraldehyde + OsO4 fixation → ethanol dehydration → epoxy-resin embedding → ultrathin sectioning (50–70 nm) → uranyl acetate + lead citrate staining → TEM. (0.5 pt)
戊二醛+OsO4 固定 → 乙醇脱水 → 环氧树脂包埋 → 超薄切片(50–70 nm) → 醋酸铀酰+柠檬酸铅染色 → TEM。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 2.md::### Q1 — Image formation & distortion (2 pt)::0
cards.q_en: ** Explain the main steps of image formation in an EM, and why the image is distorted.
cards.q_zh: ** 解释电镜成像的主要步骤，以及图像为何扭曲。
cards.a:
Electrons are accelerated (λ = h/mv); condenser lens makes a parallel beam; electrons scatter in the sample → amplitude contrast (particle view) + phase contrast (wave view, scattered electrons delayed by π/2). (1 pt)
电子加速（λ=h/mv）→ 聚光镜平行束 → 样品散射 → 振幅衬度（粒子观） + 相位衬度（波动观，散射电子相位延迟 π/2）。（1 分）
Distorted by spherical Cs, chromatic Cc, astigmatism + underfocus; in Fourier space, image = real × CTF. (1 pt)
扭曲：球差 Cs、色差 Cc、像散 + 欠焦；傅里叶空间 图像 = 真实图像 × CTF。（1 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 2.md::### Q2 — From particles to 2D class averages (1.5 pt)::1
cards.q_en: ** Give the main steps to obtain 2D class averages from picked particles, and why each is important.
cards.q_zh: ** 给出从挑选颗粒得到二维平均类的步骤及每步意义。
cards.a:
Translation (center) → rotation (align) → classification (MSA/Bayesian) → averaging (S/N √N), 0.375 pt each. (1.5 pt)
平移（居中）→ 旋转（对齐）→ 分类（MSA/Bayesian）→ 平均（信噪比 √N），各 0.375 分。（1.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 2.md::### Q3 — Symmetry of the complex (0.5 pt)::2
cards.q_en: ** What is the symmetry of the complex? Explain why.
cards.q_zh: ** 复合物的对称性？为什么？
cards.a:
D2 (three orthogonal two-fold axes). WHY: 400 kDa / 100 kDa = 4 subunits, a tetramer arranged as D2 (like β-galactosidase). (0.5 pt)
D2（三个正交二重轴）。WHY：400 kDa / 100 kDa = 4 个亚基，四聚体排布为 D2（如 β-半乳糖苷酶）。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 2.md::### Q4 — Euler sphere & asymmetric unit (1 pt)::3
cards.q_en: ** On a Euler sphere, show the asymmetric unit and give Euler angles of its borders.
cards.q_zh: ** 在欧拉球上标出不对称单元及边界欧拉角。
cards.a:
Draw a Euler sphere. D2 has 4 symmetry operations → asymmetric unit = 1/4 of the sphere. (0.5 pt)
画欧拉球。D2 有 4 个对称操作 → 不对称单元 = 欧拉球的 1/4。（0.5 分）
Border Euler angles (as in the D4 example): (0,0,0), (0,90,0), (90,90,0). (0.5 pt)
边界欧拉角（类 D4 例子）：(0,0,0), (0,90,0), (90,90,0)。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 2.md::### Q5 — Retrieving missing information (0.5 pt)::4
cards.q_en: ** Explain the strategy to retrieve the information missing in single images.
cards.q_zh: ** 解释找回单张图像缺失信息的策略。
cards.a:
Collect many projections at different orientations + assign Euler angles + 3D reconstruction fills the missing views. (0.5 pt)
采集大量不同取向投影 + 分配欧拉角 + 三维重构补全缺失视角。（0.5 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 2.md::### Q6 — Common line method (1 pt)::5
cards.q_en: ** Explain the strategy to obtain relative angles between class averages (common line method).
cards.q_zh: ** 解释用共线法求类平均相对角度。
cards.a:
Central section theorem + common line: two class averages' FT sections intersect along a common line; its direction difference gives the relative Euler angles. (1 pt)
中心截面定理 + 共线：两个类平均 FT 截面交于一条共线，其方向差异给出相对欧拉角。（1 分）

cards.id: Mock Exam 2.md::### Q7 — Improve resolution of a flexible region (2 pt)::6
cards.q_en: ** A flexible loop is less resolved and appears in two conformations. Explain a strategy to improve its resolution.
cards.q_zh: ** 一个柔性 loop 分辨率低且呈两种构象。解释提高其分辨率的策略。
cards.a:
Signal subtraction (remove the rigid body) → soft-mask 3D classification (separate the two conformations) → local refinement (refine each conformation separately). (2 pt)
信号扣除（扣掉刚性主体）→ 软掩膜 3D 分类（分离两种构象）→ 局部精修（每种构象分别精修）。（2 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q1 —— 电镜成像的主要步骤；图像为何扭曲？::0
cards.a:
Electrons accelerated by high voltage (de Broglie λ = h/mv); condenser lens makes a parallel beam; electrons scatter in the sample → amplitude contrast (particle view, thicker → darker) + phase contrast (wave view, scattered electrons delayed by π/2, interference); objective lens focuses, projector magnifies, DED detects. (1 pt)
电子经高压加速（德布罗意 λ=h/mv）；聚光镜产生平行束；电子在样品中散射 → 振幅衬度（粒子观，厚区更暗）+ 相位衬度（波动观，散射电子相位延迟 π/2，干涉）；物镜聚焦，投影镜放大，直接电子探测器检测。（1 分）
Distorted by lens aberrations (spherical Cs, chromatic Cc, astigmatism) + underfocus (needed for phase contrast); in Fourier space, image = real image × CTF, which oscillates so some frequencies are lost/inverted. (1 pt)
扭曲源于透镜像差（球差 Cs、色差 Cc、像散）+ 欠焦（获得相位衬度所必需）；傅里叶空间 记录图像 = 真实图像 × CTF，CTF 振荡使某些频率丢失/反转。（1 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q2 —— 从挑选颗粒到二维平均类的步骤；为何重要？::1
cards.a:
Translation (centering) — center the particles, else the average blurs. (0.5 pt)
平移（居中）—— 否则平均会模糊。（0.5 分）
Rotation (alignment) — align same-orientation particles. (0.5 pt)
旋转（对齐）—— 对齐同取向颗粒。（0.5 分）
Classification (MSA/Bayesian) separates orientations/conformations + averaging (S/N ↑ by √N). (0.5 pt)
分类（MSA/Bayesian）分离不同取向/构象 + 平均（信噪比提高 √N）。（0.5 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q3 —— 复合物的对称性？::2
cards.a:
Octahedral symmetry (O, 432). 24 DegQ subunits form a cage; 24 = the number of symmetry operations of the 432 point group, with 1 subunit per asymmetric unit. (0.5 pt)
八面体对称（O, 432）。24 个 DegQ 亚基组成一个笼，24 = 432 点群的对称操作数，每个不对称单元含 1 个亚基。（0.5 分）
WHY: 50 kDa × 24 = 1200 kDa + 34 kDa (OMP) = 1234 kDa, matching MALLS → a 24-mer. The 2D class averages (figure above) show three principal-axis views: 4-fold (circle), 3-fold (hexagon), 2-fold (rectangle) — the signature of octahedral O symmetry, consistent with the 24-mer.
WHY：50 kDa × 24 = 1200 kDa + 34 kDa (OMP) = 1234 kDa，与 MALLS 一致 → 24 聚体。2D 类平均图（上图）显示三种主轴视图：4 重轴（圆）、3 重轴（六边）、2 重轴（矩形）——这正是八面体 O 对称的特征，与 24 聚体吻合。

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q4 —— 欧拉球、不对称单元、边界欧拉角::3
cards.a:
Draw a Euler sphere (φ, θ, ψ). Octahedral O has 24 symmetry operations → the asymmetric unit = 1/24 of the Euler sphere; search only within it. (1 pt)
画欧拉球 (φ, θ, ψ)。八面体 O 有 24 个对称操作 → 不对称单元 = 欧拉球的 1/24；只需在其中搜索。（1 分）
WHY: with symmetry, one particle image corresponds to 24 symmetry-related views; searching only the asymmetric unit shrinks the search space 24-fold, and the other views are generated by the symmetry operations. (Exact border Euler angles should be read from the Euler-sphere figure on the paper.)
WHY：有了对称性，一个颗粒图像对应 24 个对称相关视图；只搜索不对称单元可把搜索空间缩小 24 倍，其余视角由对称操作生成。（具体边界欧拉角需按卷面欧拉球图标注。）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q5 —— 找回单张图像缺失信息的策略::4
cards.a:
A single image is a 2D projection (losing the projection direction); collect many projections at different orientations + assign Euler angles + 3D reconstruction fills the missing views. (0.5 pt)
单张图只是 3D 物体的一个 2D 投影（丢失投影方向）；采集大量不同取向投影 + 分配欧拉角 + 三维重构补全缺失视角。（0.5 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q6 —— 共线法：求类平均之间的相对角度::5
cards.a:
Central section theorem: the FT of one projection = a central section through the origin of the 3D object's FT. (0.5 pt)
中心截面定理：一张投影的傅里叶变换 = 3D 物体傅里叶变换过原点的中心截面。（0.5 分）
Two class averages' FT sections intersect along a common line; its direction difference in the two sections gives their relative Euler angles. (0.5 pt)
两个类平均的 FT 截面交于一条共线；该线在两截面中的方向差异给出它们的相对欧拉角。（0.5 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q7 —— 提高配体（模糊、出现在两个位置）分辨率::6
cards.a:
The ligand is less resolved, appears in two positions, with lower intensity → local heterogeneity + low occupancy. Strategy: (0.5 pt)
配体更模糊、出现在两个位置、强度低 → 局部异质性 + 低占据率。策略：（0.5 分）
Signal subtraction: subtract the rigid chaperone → only the ligand density remains. (0.5 pt)
信号扣除：扣掉刚性良好的伴侣蛋白 → 只剩配体密度。（0.5 分）
Masked 3D classification on the ligand region → separate the two ligand positions into classes. (0.5 pt)
掩膜三维分类：在配体区域加软掩膜，把两个配体位置的颗粒分成两类。（0.5 分）
Local refinement of each ligand state with a mask. (0.5 pt)
局部精修：对每个配体状态用掩膜做聚焦精修。（0.5 分）
WHY: two positions = heterogeneity; direct refinement dilutes the signal, so separate first then refine each state.
WHY：两个位置 = 异质性；直接精修会稀释信号，先分离再分别精修才能提高该区域分辨率。
--

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q1 —— AFM 组成 + 三大应用::7
cards.a:
Components (draw & label): cantilever + tip, laser, photodiode detector, piezoelectric scanner, feedback loop. (0.5 pt)
组成（画图标注）：悬臂梁+针尖、激光、光电二极管探测器、压电扫描器、反馈回路。（0.5 分）
Three applications: ① imaging (topography of biomolecules/membranes, near-native, in liquid) ② force spectroscopy (single-molecule unfolding, receptor-ligand forces) ③ mechanical-property measurement (elasticity/stiffness/adhesion). (0.5 pt)
三大应用：① 成像（生物大分子/细胞膜表面形貌，近天然、可液体中）② 力谱（单分子解析叠、受体-配体结合力）③ 力学性质测量（弹性/刚度/黏附）。（0.5 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q2 —— TEM 图像 vs AFM 图像::8
cards.a:
TEM: electrons transmit through the sample → 2D projection (internal + surface), high vacuum, high resolution. (0.5 pt)
TEM：电子穿透样品 → 2D 投影（内部 + 表面），高真空，高分辨。（0.5 分）
AFM: tip scans the surface → 3D surface topography (direct height measurement), works in air/liquid, lateral ~nm / vertical ~Å. (0.5 pt)
AFM：针尖扫描表面 → 3D 表面形貌（高度直接测量），可大气/液体中，侧向 ~nm / 垂直 ~Å。（0.5 分）
Key difference: TEM gives a transmission projection (loses depth), AFM gives a surface height map (only surface, but direct z-height).
关键差异：TEM 是穿透投影（丢失深度方向），AFM 是表面高度图（只测表面，但直接得到 z 高度）。
--

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q1 —— SAXS 与 SANS 的三个区别::9
cards.a:
① Scattering mechanism: SAXS = X-rays scattered by electrons (∝ electron number); SANS = neutrons scattered by nuclei (varies irregularly with atom/isotope).
① 散射机制：SAXS = X 射线被电子散射（∝电子数）；SANS = 中子被核散射（随原子/同位素不规则）。
② Contrast variation: SANS allows D2O/H2O ratio + deuteration to "hide" components; SAXS almost cannot.
② 对比度变化：SANS 可通过 D2O/H2O 比例与氘化"隐藏"组分；SAXS 几乎做不到。
③ Flux/radiation/sample: SAXS high flux, fast (seconds), small sample (~15 µL), but radiation damage; SANS low flux, slow (minutes), larger sample (~150 µL), but no radiation damage.
③ 通量/辐射/样品：SAXS 高通量、快（秒级）、样品少（~15 µL）但有辐射损伤；SANS 低通量、慢（分钟级）、样品多（~150 µL）但无辐射损伤。

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q2 —— 每种体系用 SAXS 还是 SANS？::10
cards.a:
Water-soluble single-domain protein → SAXS. WHY: homogeneous single body, fast, high-throughput.
水溶性单结构域蛋白 → SAXS。WHY：均一单一体、快、高通量。
Membrane protein (detergent-solubilized) → SANS. WHY: D2O matches the detergent (hides the belt), so only the protein is seen.
膜蛋白（去垢剂增溶）→ SANS。WHY：D2O 匹配去垢剂（把去垢剂带"隐形"），只看到蛋白。
Protein–RNA complex → SANS. WHY: protein and RNA have different scattering-length densities → natural contrast (different D2O%) distinguishes the internal arrangement.
蛋白-RNA 复合物 → SANS。WHY：蛋白与 RNA 散射长度密度不同 → 天然对比度（不同 D2O%）区分内部排列。

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q3 —— 加入蛋白 B 后 I(0) 的相对变化::11
cards.a:
+21% (I(0) increases by 21%).
+21%（I(0) 增加 21%）。
WHY: I(0) ∝ (Σb)² ∝ Mr² (for a fixed particle number). After forming the 1:1 tight complex, the particle number is unchanged, but each particle's mass goes from M_A to 1.1 M_A. So I(0)_after / I(0)_before = (1.1 M_A)² / M_A² = 1.21 → a 21% increase.
WHY：I(0) ∝ (Σb)² ∝ Mr²（对固定颗粒数）。形成 1:1 紧密复合物后颗粒数不变，但每个颗粒分子量从 M_A → 1.1 M_A。I(0)_后 / I(0)_前 = (1.1 M_A)²/M_A² = 1.21 → 增加 21%。
Key point: I(0) scales with the square of the molecular weight, not linearly — amplitudes add then get squared.
关键点：I(0) 与分子量的平方成正比而非线性——振幅叠加后再平方。
--

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q1 —— PALM 与 STORM 区别；分辨率；能否区分二聚体/单体？::12
cards.a:
PALM = photoactivatable fluorescent proteins; STORM = photoswitchable organic dyes; both are SMLM. (0.5 pt)
PALM = 光激活荧光蛋白；STORM = 光开关有机染料；都是 SMLM。（0.5 分）
Both activate a sparse subset → localize single molecules → reconstruct. Spatial resolution ≈ 10–40 nm. (0.5 pt)
两者都是稀疏激活 → 单分子定位 → 重建。空间分辨率 ≈ 10–40 nm。（0.5 分）
Localization resolution alone cannot distinguish (dimer subunits <10 nm apart); but counting blinking/bleaching steps can: monomer = 1 step, dimer = 2 steps. (0.5 pt)
仅靠定位分辨率不足以区分（二聚体亚基间距 <10 nm）；但数闪烁/漂白步数可以：单体 1 步、二聚体 2 步。（0.5 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q2 —— 计数所需的化学计量标记策略::13
cards.a:
Endogenous labeling via CRISPR/Cas9 knock-in: replace the endogenous gene with an FP-fused copy → each protein carries exactly 1 fluorophore (1:1 stoichiometry). (1.25 pt)
CRISPR/Cas9 内源敲入：把内源基因替换为 FP 融合版本 → 每个蛋白恰带 1 个荧光团（1:1 化学计量）。（1.25 分）
WHY: counting requires "one protein = one fluorophore"; overexpression/random labeling breaks this ratio and corrupts the count.
WHY：计数要求"一个蛋白 = 一个荧光团"；过表达/随机标记会破坏该比例，导致计数错误。

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q3 —— 膜蛋白用什么照明方式::14
cards.a:
TIRF (total internal reflection fluorescence): only the ~100–200 nm evanescent field near the coverslip is illuminated → only plasma-membrane proteins are excited, excluding intracellular background. (0.25 pt)
TIRF（全内反射荧光）：只激发盖玻片表面 ~100–200 nm 的倏逝场 → 只照亮质膜蛋白，排除胞内背景。（0.25 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q4 —— 红转绿光转换荧光蛋白如何工作::15
cards.a:
Photoconvertible FP (e.g. mEos) starts green; 405 nm activation rearranges the chromophore → red. In super-resolution: weak 405 nm activates a sparse subset → localize each red point until bleached → activate the next batch → temporal separation → single-molecule reconstruction. (0.75 pt)
光转换荧光蛋白（如 mEos）初始发绿；405 nm 激活后发色团重排 → 红。超分辨中：弱 405 nm 只激活稀疏子集 → 逐个定位红光点直到漂白 → 激活下一批 → 时间分离 → 单分子定位重建。（0.75 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q5 —— 瞬时转染为何不能标记全部？如何全部标记？::16
cards.a:
Transient transfection → overexpression, random copy number, not all cells express, endogenous copies unlabeled → non-stoichiometric, incomplete. (0.5 pt)
瞬时转染 → 过表达、随机拷贝数、非所有细胞表达、内源蛋白未标记 → 非化学计量、非完全标记。（0.5 分）
CRISPR/Cas9 endogenous knock-in (or a stable line) → all endogenous proteins labeled 1:1. (0.25 pt)
CRISPR/Cas9 内源敲入（或稳定细胞系）→ 所有内源蛋白 1:1 标记。（0.25 分）

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q6 —— 从时间角度（光激活→漂白）区分二聚体/单体::17
cards.a:
Count photobleaching steps: monomer = 1 step; dimer = 2 steps. (0.5 pt)
数漂白步数：单体 = 1 步；二聚体 = 2 步。（0.5 分）
WHY: with an "ideal" FP (activation → bleaching), each molecule emits a finite number of photons then bleaches in one step; the number of steps = number of fluorophores = number of subunits.
WHY：理想荧光蛋白（激活→漂白）每个分子发出有限光子后一步淬灭；步数 = 荧光团数 = 亚基数。
--

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q1 —— 回答该问题的策略::18
cards.a:
Use cellular TEM (thin sections) to directly observe whether gut epithelial cells contain silver nanoparticles: fix → embed → section → stain → TEM; look for electron-dense silver particles (20 nm) inside cells.
用细胞 TEM 超薄切片直接观察肠上皮细胞内部是否含银纳米颗粒：固定 → 包埋 → 切片 → 染色 → TEM；在细胞内部寻找电子致密的银颗粒（20 nm）。

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q2 —— 用哪种显微镜？为什么？::19
cards.a:
TEM. WHY: silver (high atomic number) is electron-dense → high-contrast dark dots; TEM resolution is enough to see 20 nm particles and their subcellular compartment (endocytic vesicles, lysosomes).
TEM。WHY：银（高原子序数）电子致密 → 高衬度黑点；TEM 分辨力足以看清 20 nm 颗粒及其所在区室（内吞囊泡、溶酶体）。

cards.id: ANNALE - Exam Solutions.md::## Q3 —— 如何制备生物样品？::20
cards.a:
① Chemical fixation: glutaraldehyde (crosslinks proteins) + OsO4 (fixes membranes/lipids, adds electron contrast). ② Ethanol dehydration. ③ Epoxy-resin embedding. ④ Ultrathin sectioning (50–70 nm). ⑤ Staining: uranyl acetate + lead citrate. ⑥ TEM imaging.
① 化学固定：戊二醛（交联蛋白）+ OsO4（固定膜/脂质，增强电子衬度）。② 乙醇脱水。③ 环氧树脂包埋。④ 超薄切片（50–70 nm）。⑤ 染色：醋酸铀酰 + 柠檬酸铅。⑥ TEM 成像。
WHY: silver particles are already dense, but the cellular context (membranes, organelles) needs OsO4/heavy-metal staining to reveal the subcellular location of the particles.
WHY：银颗粒本身已致密，但细胞背景（膜、细胞器）需 OsO4/重金属染色才能看清颗粒的亚细胞定位。
--
